ghiChu: §11.4 + §12.5 do bang BAN PHIM THAT (Input.dispatchKeyEvent). Moi buoc `key` doc lai DAU DO `keydown` da cai tren trang ⇒ phan biet 'su kien KHONG TOI' voi 'app KHONG XU LY' (ERRATA #47 muc 5), va mot buoc `key` ma dau do RONG lam luot chay DO (I2, vong sua 1). Canh bao hinh dang: `?` gui KEM Shift; `Enter` gui kem PHA KY TU text='\r'.
